abort.settings_exist: The shared settings already exist. Change them with Configure on their entry.

error.own_entity: Select the real thermostat, not an entity created by this integration.

settings.title: Shared settings
settings.description: These sensors are shared by all rooms and rarely change. Change them later with Configure on this entry. Add each room afterwards with Add entry. The water temperature is set on the What the Heat page.

data_description.outdoor_entity: Preferably in the shade. Each room learns how much more heat it needs when it is colder outside than usual.
data_description.pv_entity: The current power of a PV installation, preferably read locally. It tells each room how much sun there is, so that the room can learn what the sun does to it.

user.title: Add a room
user.description: A new room starts in active mode and controls the thermostat right away. Its Mode entity switches it to observe mode, which only calculates, or hands the thermostat back.

data_description.phase_offset: Set different values for different rooms, so that they do not all open together.
Set different values for different rooms, so that they do not all open together.

settings.title: Shared settings
settings.description: These sensors are shared by all rooms. A sensor left empty is removed.

data_description.outdoor_entity: Preferably in the shade. Each room learns how much more heat it needs when it is colder outside than usual.
data_description.pv_entity: The current power of a PV installation, preferably read locally. It tells each room how much sun there is, so that the room can learn what the sun does to it.

set_water_temperature.name: Set water temperature
set_water_temperature.description: Sets the temperature of the water going into the floors, for all rooms. It only tells the controller what the water temperature is, and changes nothing on the heat source.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: The temperature set on the mixing valves.
